name: com.fugte/widgets
title: Fugte
description: Save a widget your AI chat wrote to Fugte, where it stays editable without code and embeds anywhere

tools.name: save_widget
tools.description: Save a widget (HTML, CSS and JavaScript) to Fugte and get a link for the user. Use it when the user wants the widget on a site built with a no-code builder such as Canva, Wix, Squarespace, Shopify, Notion, Google Sites, Carrd or WordPress, or wants to keep changing it later. The link opens the widget in the Fugte editor. The user signs in (free) and publishes it, which gives them the embed link for their site. Publishing is free. Send one complete, working, self-contained widget: no build step, and no import, export or require. Libraries, images and fonts can load from https links. The link works for 7 days.

title.description: A short name for the widget, such as "Music player" or "RSVP form".

html.description: The widget's HTML: a full page or a fragment. It may already hold its <style> and <script> tags.

css.description: CSS that is not already in a <style> tag in the HTML. Leave it out otherwise.

js.description: Plain browser JavaScript that is not already in a <script> tag in the HTML. No modules.
